Technical repeats measure the same material again: three tubes or ten wells from one donor still represent one donor. Twelve measurements from three donors therefore require an analysis that accounts for repeated measurements, rather than treating all twelve as independent people. Error bars must be defined. Standard deviation describes observation variability, standard error concerns precision of an estimated mean, and a confidence interval follows a specified procedure and assumptions.
